issues.issue: Is comparator wage data factually relevant to whether an applicant performed the duties of the NOC occupation?
issues.respondent_position: Officer relied on wages below local rates and a duty description not matching NOC 1242; Minister's own submissions are not separately stated.
issues.result_quote: Accordingly, it was reasonable for the visa officer to consult the extensive prevailing minimum and average wage data for these occupations

issues.issue: May a visa officer consider comparator wage data when assessing CEC work experience under s.87.1 of the Regulations?
issues.applicant_position: Wage provisions for FSW and TWP show Parliament meant wages not to count for CEC; officers lack HRSDC's labour-market expertise.
issues.result_quote: section 87.1 of the Regulations clearly authorizes a visa officer to take comparator wage information into account

issues.issue: What standard of review applies to a visa officer's interpretation of the Regulations and to the officer's factual findings?
issues.result_quote: Correctness is the applicable standard in this case for reviewing the visa officer’s interpretation of section 87.1 of the Regulations
